title: feat(print): render a page that declares `print` — print CSS, printable blocks whole, record print action (objectui#11958)
body:
Fixes #11958

Clause-②: yes

Card ② of the ruling of record `6051470224` on objectstack#8346 (letter B′): a page that declares `print` now prints as a document, the printable blocks reach paper whole, and the record page offers a Print action (M1, zero server).

## What changed

| Area | Where it landed | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Print stylesheet | `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-print.ts` (new), `page.tsx` | `PageRenderer` stamps `data-print-page` on a page whose `print` is an object, mounts a stylesheet built from the declaration, and publishes the declaration through `PrintPageProvider`. Every rule is inside `@media print`. |
| Running header / footer | `page.tsx` (`RunningRegions`) | With `repeatHeader` / `repeatFooter`, the page's own `header` / `footer` region goes in a real `thead` / `tfoot`. On screen the table, its sections, rows and cells are `display: contents`, so the regions stay the layout's flex children. |
| Print context | `packages/react/src/context/PrintPageContext.tsx` (new) | `PrintPageProvider`, `usePrintPage()` and `PrintPageContext`. `usePrintPage()` returns the page's `print` declaration, or `null` outside a print page. |
| `record:line_items` | `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` | On a print page the read asks for one probe row past the cap and `$count: true`. When the probe comes back, the panel draws the cap's rows and the shared `NonGridRowCeilingNote` under them. The note names both numbers when the server reports a total. Off a print page the wire and the panel are unchanged. |
| `record:details` | `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` | A collapsible section draws open on a print page, because Radix unmounts a closed section's rows. |
| Record page Print action | `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` | When the page bound to the record declares `print`, a Print button (`record-print-button`) calls `window.print()`. Other record pages get no button. |
| PDF sentence | `types/src/objectql.ts`, `ListView.tsx` (two comments), `ReportViewer.tsx`, app-shell `styles.css`, app-shell `DashboardView.tsx` | Rewritten the way card ① rewrote `LIST_VIEW_EXPORT_PDF_RETIRED`: a printable document is a page that declares `print`. `DashboardView.tsx` is a fifth site in app-shell that card ①'s measurement did not list. |
| Docs | `content/docs/guide/print-pages.md` (new, plus `meta.json`), `packages/react/README.md` | The print page, each key's print CSS, the blocks that print whole, and the Print action. |

**Landing point outside the claimed surface:** the page renderer is `PageRenderer` in `@object-ui/components`. It renders every page's regions, for both `PageView` and `RecordDetailView`, so it owns the print stylesheet. The context had to live in `@object-ui/react` so that `plugin-form` and `plugin-detail` can read it. The line-items and detail-section edits are in their own packages because those packages own the two block renderers.

## Per key: read now? (ledger rows in `@objectstack/spec/liveness/page.json`, all `planned` naming this card)

| Key | Read now | Print CSS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `print` (the declaration) | yes | stamps the page, mounts the sheet, publishes the context |
| `paperSize` | yes | `@page { size: SIZE ORIENTATION }`, A4 when omitted |
| `orientation` | yes | same rule, portrait when omitted |
| `margins.top` / `.right` / `.bottom` / `.left` | yes | one `@page` `margin-SIDE: Nmm` per declared side. A side left out keeps the console's 12mm default from `styles.css`. |
| `repeatHeader` | yes | `header` region in a `thead` |
| `repeatFooter` | yes | `footer` region in a `tfoot` |
| `pageNumbers` | yes | `@bottom-right { content: counter(page) " / " counter(pages) }` |
| `repeatTableHeaders` | yes | `thead { display: table-header-group }` (on when omitted). `false` gives `table-row-group`. |
| `avoidBreakInside` | yes | `break-inside: avoid` on each block of a region |

The ledger flip (`planned` to `live`, dropping `authorWarn` / `authorHint`) is an objectstack edit at the `.objectui-sha` pin that carries this PR. This PR does not make that edit.

## Real-render measurement (Chromium 141.0.7390.37, one-off, not a repo file)

A replica of the `RecordDetailView` / `PageRenderer` DOM was printed to PDF. It had the shell's `h-svh` / `overflow-hidden` chain, the record view's own chrome and fallback panel, and a 120-line table in `main`. The stylesheet was the one `buildPagePrintStylesheet` emits for `{ paperSize: 'A5', repeatHeader: true, repeatFooter: true, pageNumbers: true, margins: { top: 12, bottom: 12, left: 10, right: 10 } }`. Per-sheet text came from `pdftotext`:

- **Print page:** 5 sheets, page size `420 x 594.96 pts (A5)`. The letterhead, the footer and the table's `thead` appear on all 5 sheets. The page numbers read `1/5` … `5/5`. All 120 lines are present, and no console chrome string appears.
- **Control (same DOM, no print page):** 1 sheet at the default Letter size. 3 chrome strings are present and only 38 of the 120 lines, because the viewport chain clips the rest.
- **First attempt, kept as a finding:** the running regions were first drawn with `display: table-header-group` on the region `div`s. In Chromium that printed the letterhead on sheet 1 only and the footer on the last sheet only. A real `thead` / `tfoot` repeats on every sheet; a CSS-display table does not, and isolated experiments showed the same. That result is why the regions sit in a real table that is `display: contents` on screen.
- **Screen identity:** with and without the `display: contents` table, the bounding boxes of the header, main and footer regions are identical (`identical true`).

A print page with no running regions is DOM-identical to the same page without `print`, apart from the attribute and the style element.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/lineItemsPrintRowCap-11958.test.tsx` (6). The probe row and `$count`, the note with and without a reported total, and three controls.

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.printAction-11958.test.tsx` (2). The action calls the print preview, and the page is a print page. Control: no `print` means no action and no print page.
- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/printable-blocks-registered-11958.test.ts`. Every type in the spec's `PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` (read from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, with no second list kept) has a registered renderer, plus a control.

The warnings on added lines are the moved `Record` of `string` to `any` cast in `LineItemsPanel` and the `react-refresh/only-export-components` pair on the new context file, which has the same shape as `PreviewModeContext`.

## Clause ② — measured on the built declarations

- `@object-ui/react` **widens**. `dist/context/PrintPageContext.d.ts` is re-exported by `dist/context/index.d.ts`, so `PrintPageContext`, `PrintPageProvider` and `usePrintPage` are new public exports. Control: `usePreviewMode` resolves in `dist/context/PreviewModeContext.d.ts`. At base `b9814b3`, `git grep usePrintPage -- packages/react/src` exits 1, and the control `usePreviewMode` exits 0. The changeset is `minor`.
- `@object-ui/types` **does not widen in this PR**. `PageNodeSchema` already carried `print` by reference (`Omit` of the spec `Page` over `PAGE_SPEC_EXCLUDED`) since objectui#12030's `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.0 bump; type-check confirms `schema.print` is typed as the spec enum. This PR's diff under `packages/types/src` is comment lines only, so the mirror the claim anticipated was already in place.
- `@object-ui/components` emits `dist/renderers/layout/page-print.d.ts`, but no `.d.ts` reachable from the package's only export `.` references it, so its public surface is unchanged. The behaviour change is `minor`.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- **The binding fork (open question in the report).** "The bound page" is read here as the record page `usePageAssignment` already picks for the object, which is the first `type: 'record'` page. Binding a SEPARATE print page next to a normal record page would need a selection rule this repo does not have. Today a second record page for the same object never renders. That needs a decision and is not done here.
- The other `objectstack#1301` "declined" sentences outside this card's surface: `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (export-format comment), and the headers of `print-stylesheet-4462.test.ts`, `ListView.printButtonSemantics.test.tsx`, `ReportViewer.printButtonSemantics.test.tsx`, `exportGate.test.tsx` and `objectql.exportOptions.test.ts`. They are comments, and no carrier is named.
- `record:highlights` values use `truncate` (an ellipsis on a long value), so a very long highlight value is cut on paper as it is on screen. Not changed here.
- A `record:line_items` panel on a print page is still the editable grid. On paper it prints its Save button and inputs as drawn.

Implemented by the dispatched `os-dev` run in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` (seat `domain:ui#2`).
